rows: Engineering (B.Tech or B.E.), computing, B.Sc, architecture, data and most non-medical degrees.
MBBS, BDS and other NEET medical courses, which need Biology. Veterinary science and some life-science degrees also ask for Biology.
Most commerce and humanities degrees do not ask for Science, so moving later is mostly a question of the school rule. Ask in writing.
BA subjects, law, psychology, journalism, teaching, design routes and civil services preparation alongside a degree.
Engineering, medical courses and most B.Sc science degrees.
Many arts degrees ask for no fixed subject. Moving into science later is hard.
Work or training earlier. Diploma holders can often enter the second year of B.Tech through lateral entry. NIOS senior secondary counts as Class 12.
For diploma and ITI, the direct school route to NEET or JEE, which need specific Class 12 subjects. With NIOS those doors stay open if you pick the right subjects.

Lateral entry has marks conditions (AICTE's 2022 rule asked for 45 percent in the diploma, 40 percent for SC and ST candidates), and NIOS lets you choose subjects. Check both on the official page before you decide.
